newsitem.title: USA: Man attempts suicide on Southwest flight.
newsitem.headline: Man attempts suicide on Southwest flight.

text.p: An airline passenger tried to commit suicide on a Southwest Airlines flight on Wednesday by slashing at his throat with a pocket knife in an on-board lavatory.
Airline officials said a flight attendant found the man and the pilot made an emergency landing at Phoenix Sky Harbour International Airport so the man could be taken to a hospital.

"He attempted suicide in the front lavatory with a Swiss army knife or some kind of pocket knife," spokeswoman Amy Lyons said. "He had not come out for some time so the flight attendant decided to go in and see what had happened."
She said passengers are not restricted from carrying pocket knifes onto planes.

Airport director Dutch Bertholf said the man was conscious when he was taken from the plane to a nearby hospital but his condition was not immediately known. "An attempted suicide can happen anywhere but it is pretty unusual when it comes to airplanes," he said.
The flight, with 62 passengers on board, was on its way from Albuquerque to San Diego when the incident occurred over Arizona.
